'''Xandanks''', often called '''crustacean cats''', were dangerous [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creatures native to the lava [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. They were pack hunters that hunted their prey in well-coordinated teams.

The Xandank was one of the few known [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that had both an [[Exoskeleton|exo-]] and endo-[[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]], making it very strong and extremely well [[Armor/Legends|armored]].

At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Jedi Knight]] owned a Xandank named [[Cobak (Xandank)|Cobak]]. The beast was very loyal, it followed the Jedi's order to watch over his hidden belongings for almost two decades after the Jedi had to flee from [[Order 66/Legends|attacking]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] due to Order 66.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Xandank_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Xandank appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> One of the loading screens of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' erroneously calls it "Xandak".
